Criterion: Verify that each non-over-wing exit higher than 6 feet off the ground has a means to assist passengers to the ground. Provisions should exist for evacuees to be assisted to the ground from the wing when the exit opens to the wing. Standard (Air Force): For each exit that is not over the wing and is more than 6 feet above the ground when the aircraft is on level ground with landing gear down, a means for rapid and safe decent to the ground is provided for passengers that requires no training to use with assistance from aircrew. For exits opening to wing areas, provisions are incorporated to safely assist passengers from the wing surface to ground level. Method of Compliance (Air Force): Analysis, inspection and demonstration documentation verify which exits are more than 6 feet above the ground, that non-over-wing exits of that set have a means for passenger descent, and that these descent devices can be used without passenger training but with the assistance of aircrew members. Emergency egress demonstrations using non-trained personnel, representative of the expected passenger population verify the ability to safely exit and descend to the ground. References: JSSG-2010-7: 3.7.5.3.2 JSSG-2010-13: 3.13.5 14 CFR 25.810, 121.31a

Standard: Emergency ground evacuation provisions are provided as follows: a. Provide a means to descend to the ground without injury for all occupants. b. A means to descend is provided for each exit that is not over the wing and more than 6 ft above the ground when the air vehicle is on level ground with landing gear down. c. For exits opening to wing areas, provisions are incorporated to assist occupants from the wing surface to ground level. It is acceptable to require training for crewmembers. For passengers, no training is necessary to descend without injury. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of drawings or digital models verifies that all exits have a means for occupant descent.
(2) Examination of drawings or digital models verifies that exits more than 6 ft above the ground and non-overwing exits provide a means for occupant descent.
(3) Examination of procedures verifies that descent devices can be used without passenger training but with the assistance of crewmembers. Demonstration.
  (1) For crewmembers, demonstrate the ability to exit and descend to the ground during an emergency egress test. Demonstrations are accomplished using personnel representative of the intended anthropometric population in representative equipment configurations. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) For passengers, demonstrate the ability to exit and descend to the ground during an emergency egress test. Demonstrations are accomplished using untrained personnel representative of the intended anthropometric population.
